The '''VES-700 pulse rifle''' was a model of [[Pulse rifle/Legends|pulse rifle]] designed by [[Corondexx/Legends|Corondexx]]. It was very useful in close-quarters combat since it had a wide blast cone. It could fire 5 shots, each releasing hundreds of small ion bursts, before the [[Power cell/Legends|power pack]] needed to be replaced. This weapon was favored by outlaws such as [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] and [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] who might find themselves trapped within a confined environment, such as in urban environments or aboard [[Starship/Legends|starships]]. Unlike a normal, single-fire [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]], the pulse rifle dealt a cone of energy damage, striking multiple targets within a 9-[[Meter/Legends|meter]] area. It was considered illegal to own this weapon.<ref name="SV" />
